- Mateo: please confirm AV/stream test windows and whether we need a pre-record fallback.

3) Post-event: capture annotated transcript and raise any model-regression alerts with the Applied ML team (Grace, please flag any odd outputs during the demo).

Fallback SMEs: myself, Grace O'Connor. Mateo will be backup for playback.
